animations.notes: Gatsby has no built-in animation engine. framer-motion is common but not universal.

quirks.description: Gatsby wraps all content in #___gatsby > #gatsby-focus-wrapper. Section discovery must account for this nesting.
quirks.workaround: Use primarySelector '#___gatsby > #gatsby-focus-wrapper > main > *' to reach actual sections.

quirks.description: gatsby-plugin-image uses [data-gatsby-image-wrapper] container with [data-main-image] for actual image and [data-placeholder-image] for blur-up placeholder.
quirks.workaround: Extract the data-main-image src for the actual image. Ignore the base64 placeholder.

quirks.description: Gatsby injects <link rel='prefetch'> tags for route preloading. These are not part of visible content.
quirks.workaround: Skip all <link> elements in section discovery and style extraction.

quirks.description: Gatsby stores serialized page props in /page-data/<path>/page-data.json. Contains componentChunkName, path, result, staticQueryHashes, and slicesMap (v5).
quirks.workaround: Can fetch structured content from /page-data/<path>/page-data.json if DOM extraction is insufficient.

quirks.description: Gatsby sites commonly use CSS-in-JS: Emotion (style[data-emotion-css]) or styled-components (style[data-styled]). Also gatsby-global-css style[data-identity].
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles rather than parsing CSS-in-JS class names.

quirks.description: Gatsby renders a single #___gatsby div as the only meaningful body child. bodyDirectChildSections will always be 1. Section discovery must unwrap through #gatsby-focus-wrapper.
quirks.workaround: spaContainerHints handle unwrapping. Ignore SPA detection flag for Gatsby — it serves static HTML.

quirks.description: Gatsby auto-injects <meta name='generator' content='Gatsby X.Y.Z'> with exact version. Can be stripped by gatsby-plugin-remove-generator.
quirks.workaround: Use for version detection (v4 vs v5 affects features). Do not rely on it as sole detection signal.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
